answer: The canyon counter is kept in marble and plume reveals each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 578 identities would post 3407 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
